SHAIK SUHANA Data Engineer | Data Management Analyst | 5+ Years of Experience

shaiksuhana122024@gmail.com | 6305252215 | github.com/suhanashaik87 | Hyderabad, India | linkedin.com/in/shaik- suhana-51737416a

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience spanning ETL development, data governance, and data quality across insurance and financial services. Skilled in metadata management, data quality frameworks, data cataloging, and data lineage documentation, with hands-on experience supporting a large-scale legacy data warehouse migration from Teradata to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Strong foundation in SQL, ETL pipelines (Informatica IICS), and Power BI reporting, with a growing focus on cloud- native data governance practices. Actively building skills in AI-driven data engineering, including Python for automation, GenAI/LLM concepts, and applying AI-assisted approaches to data quality and metadata workflows. Proven track record of partnering with Data Stewards and Architects to strengthen enterprise data trust, and of improving data accuracy and pipeline efficiency for business intelligence solutions.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Data Governance • Metadata Management • Data Cataloging • Data Lineage • Data Quality • Data Profiling • ETL/ELT Development • Data Integration • Data Modeling • Data Warehousing • Cloud Migration • Schema Mapping • Business Glossary & Data Dictionary • SQL • Python • AI/GenAI & LLM Fundamentals • AI-Assisted Data Quality • Stakeholder Communication • Agile Delivery • BFSI & Insurance Domain

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Data Management Analyst | Wells Fargo Hyderabad, India

Feb 2025 – Present

Support enterprise data governance initiatives by managing metadata across critical data assets, improving data cataloging, traceability, and lineage documentation.

Design and execute data quality checks and validation rules to monitor accuracy, completeness, and consistency of key data elements across source and target systems.

Contribute to a large-scale migration of the enterprise data warehouse from Teradata to Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including schema mapping analysis, data validation, and reconciliation between legacy and cloud environments.

Partner with Data Stewards, Data Architects, and business teams to define and maintain governance policies, metadata standards, and business glossary / data dictionary entries.

Document data quality issues and governance gaps, driving remediation with cross-functional teams to strengthen enterprise data trust and compliance.

Software Engineer | Cognizant Hyderabad, India

Sep 2021 – Dec 2024

Enhanced ETL processes using SQL, improving data accuracy by 40% and reducing data processing time by 20% for Power BI reporting.

Designed, developed, and maintained ETL processes to support enterprise data warehousing and business intelligence solutions.

Optimized data management pipelines, ensuring high data quality standards for business intelligence tasks. • Developed and maintained data mappings, workflows, and session tasks across ETL tools, supporting large-scale customer



and sales data integration projects. Implemented error handling and logging mechanisms to monitor and resolve data migration issues, and automated ETL processes using scheduling tools.

TECHNICAL EXPERTISE

Data Governance Metadata Management | Data Cataloging | Data Lineage | Business Glossary & Data Dictionary | Governance Policy Support Data Quality DQ Rule Design & Validation | Data Profiling | Completeness / Accuracy / Consistency Checks | Issue Triage & Remediation Tracking

Cloud & Migration Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) | Teradata | Legacy-to-Cloud DW Migration | Schema Mapping | Post- Migration Validation ETL & Integration Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) | ETL/ELT Pipelines | Data Integration & Transformation Programming & Analytics SQL | Python | Excel | Power BI | Data Modeling (ER Diagrams, Normalization) AI & Emerging Tech GenAI / LLM Fundamentals | AI-Assisted Data Quality & Metadata Workflows | Prompt Engineering Basics | Exploring RAG & Agentic AI Concepts Ways of Working Data Mapping & Workflow Documentation | Cross-Functional Collaboration | Agile Delivery | Stakeholder Communication

PROJECTS

Sales Data Migration for Retail Company | SQL

Analyzed source and target systems to understand data structures and relationships, and developed ETL workflows to extract sales data from legacy systems, including SQL databases and flat files. Implemented error handling and logging mechanisms to monitor and resolve data migration issues.



Customer Data Integration for Insurance Company | MS Excel, SQL

Designed and developed ETL processes to extract data from CRM systems, flat files, and external databases, and built complex mappings and workflows to handle large volumes of data and incremental loads.

Collaborated with business analysts to understand data requirements and automated ETL processes using scheduling tools, ensuring data availability for reporting.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering 2017 – 2021 JNTUK | CGPA: 8.76

KEY STRENGTHS

Ability to quickly learn new technologies, such as Python and cloud platforms, and apply them to automate manual processes.

Strong problem-solving skills with a track record of taking ownership of report validation, data quality checks, and governance documentation.

Effective communicator, able to translate technical data concepts for non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across teams.

Strong time management and multitasking skills, able to prioritize work and meet deadlines in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
